records.profile_description: A Cantonese lexical verb-object compound is licensed by item-specific independent evidence and forms one VP/predicate unit while retaining visible verbal and nominal-looking components. Membership is closed and source-linked rather than generated from arbitrary verb+noun order; ordinary transparent V-NP syntax, unresolved conventionalized activity expressions, unsupported lexical substitutions, and separated forms lacking item-specific evidence remain outside this identity.
records.status_recommendation: retain research_pending; the lexical verb-object-compound domain is independently supported, but runtime migration, complete lexical membership and separability boundaries, reviewed corpus diversity, role-neutral panel evidence, and held-out validation remain separate gates

additional_research: Bodomo, Yu & Che 2017 is independently reviewed in the Issue 744 source inventory as direct Cantonese V-O-compound evidence, including 游水 and ordinary-VP contrasts.
Chan & Cheung 2020 is independently reviewed in the Issue 744 source inventory for lexically restricted and gradient Cantonese V-O-compound separability.

records.rationale: Behavior-first re-audit shows that the legacy ProductiveVO whitelist conflates ordinary V-NP syntax, genuine lexical V-O compounds, unresolved conventionalized activities, and higher composition. Independent sources nevertheless establish a real Cantonese verb-object-compound domain with lexical and item-specific separability restrictions. This is a narrowing rather than a true split: ordinary transparent predicate-object behavior already has AB78 TransitiveVP, while unresolved activities and transition blockers are not promoted into new successor constructions. Retain the permanent AB35 UUID/code for the surviving source-backed compound domain, replace the unsupported ProductiveVO name with the source-aligned VerbObjectCompound name, and preserve ProductiveVO only as the legacy runtime/former name until a separately reviewed runtime migration.
unresolved_blockers: migrate the broad legacy ProductiveVO runtime compatibility whitelist through a separately reviewed source-first runtime change
implement the initial source-linked compound seed only for independently supported current-whitelist entries 飲茶, 游水, and 沖涼 without inferring arbitrary V+noun productivity
preserve compound-internal component provenance without automatically assigning the nominal-looking component an ordinary semantic object role
rehome directly supported ordinary V-NP material such as 做功課 through AB78 in a separate runtime change
resolve the transition blockers 煮嘢食, 下棋, and 做運動 independently
keep 食飯, 打電話, 打籃球, and other conventionalized activity candidates unresolved until item-specific evidence settles their analysis
complete reviewed corpus, role-neutral panel, negative-boundary, and held-out gates before any linguistic promotion
